sources.title: Film Estonia (Estonian Film Institute): FAQ (Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-43 copy, captured 2026-10-17)
sources.said: The Film Estonia production incentive is open for: feature film (the length of the film at least 60 minutes) with a budget of at least € 1 million; … animation series with overall budget of at least € 500 000; scripted television series with a budget of at least € 100 000 per single episode; post-production of all the above-mentioned works. … The level of support is determined by amount of the Estonian production costs that are both eligible and directly spent on parties that are subject to Estonian taxation, multiplied by 30% or 40%. … 1) 40% if the Estonian production stage team has hired at least 2 creative employees who are tax residents of Estonia; … Feature film, documentary film, high-quality television series < 2,000,000 25% … ≥ 2,000,000 500 000 EUR … overhead costs of the applicant and production fee (up to 15% of the Estonian production budget);

figures.finding: The Estonian Film Institute's domestic production support (Film Art Regulation) was not re-read; filmi.ee reset earlier sessions. Rate of yes unknown. EFI funds a series' development only (and a documentary series' post-production); no EFI page read today offers a production grant for a drama series, so a series' production money is Film Estonia's rebate (item 1, first wave) plus the broadcaster. The yes rate is counted from EFI's own published list of submitted applications and their decisions, 2026 to date (10 TV-minisari development applications, 3 granted); the 2025 decisions table lists 3 awards but the 2025 application list wasn't loaded (the page filters by year in the browser). Kultuurkapital's audiovisual endowment was not read for series terms.
